{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Vocal duets fit my recent interest in polished ensemble singing and musical-theatre albums; I would choose this today.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in orchestral music and vocal ensembles right now than contemporary solo pop.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not connect as closely with my current soundtrack and classical listening interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal harmonies appeal to me, but I would save Christmas music for the holiday season.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently looking for an Adele album, and this listing's title is unclear.
ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A rock retrospective is less appealing today than the vocal and relaxing classical music I have been choosing.

ItemID: NA; Title: 21 Number Ones; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A country hits collection could suit my interest in 747 and Golden, but I would prioritize gentler listening this time.
